name: FH sell path burns the sold amount from the FH/USDT pair before the sale
summary: On a sale to the FH/USDT pair, FHToken._transfer burns 80% of the after-fee amount from the pair, moves 20% to the treasury and syncs before the sold tokens arrive. Buys need a whitelisted recipient, but a whitelisted PancakeSwap router's public sweepToken releases held tokens. An attacker looped flash-loaned buys to that router, sweeps and sells.
notes: Immutable token; the constructor set the pair, the router whitelist and tradingEnabled, and the only later owner writes are two setBuyerWhitelist calls for addresses the exploit did not use.
The pair's FH burned or moved to project wallets is the same liquidity as the drained USDT and is not added. The pair had no other USDT outflow.
